page.heading: Ask the web, on your terms
page.explainer: Research is explicitly invoked and honest about what leaves: Cogeto minimises the query, shows you exactly what would be sent, and sends nothing until you approve it. Fetched pages become inspectable, deletable web memories.
page.intentPlaceholder: e.g. GDPR consent requirements when migrating a CRM

gate.heading: Approve what leaves
gate.explainer: Nothing has been sent. This is the exact query that will reach public search engines if you approve. Edit it freely first.
gate.queryLabel: The query that will be sent
gate.editedNote: · You edited the query. Your text is what will be sent.

results.heading: Results: pick the pages worth reading
results.sentQuery: Sent query: <q>{{query}}</q>, recorded on this run and on every memory this research produces.
results.fetchNote: Pages are fetched by this instance, robots-respecting, never rendered.

empty.title: No results
empty.body: The engines returned nothing for this query. Start a new research with different wording.

answer.heading: Answer: every claim traceable
answer.note: Web citations link to the page as fetched; the facts persist as web memories you can inspect and delete from the Memories page.
